milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The crafting table is at spawn-relative (1, 1, 5) in the front room. max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually entered the front room of the building (spawn is at origin, ~5.1 blocks from the table, so the player must move slightly forward into the room). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the crafting table, confirming visual discovery.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The potted fern is at spawn-relative (3, 1, 9) in the back room behind the dividing wall. max_distance=5 ensures the player has navigated through the interior doorway into the back room (~9.5 blocks from spawn, so they must walk well past the front room). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the potted fern, confirming visual discovery.
